title: Fix Slice Progress Step Wording
description: Fix the repo run progress line for a timed read step: no raw unit-label text and no trailing N of M counter that reads as past 100% for a time estimate. Keep en and de consistent.
summary: Pending verification. The progress step line no longer prints the raw counter label or a trailing N of M counter; step lines render as "(S s, expected|beyond the expected B s): phase" in en and de, and the watchdog parser reads that form. Tests updated; the repo test run has not yet passed because the shared replica's graph service failed during planning (unrelated missing worker dir and cache ledger errors).
